Use case: illustration-story. Production art for The Midnight Mill, Chapter 5. Create ONE seamless 2x2 atlas of FOUR distinct complete landscape 3:2 paintings, overall 3:2 canvas, preferably 3072x2048. EXACT equal quadrants, no gutters, borders, separators, captions, letters or watermark. Each quadrant is displayed separately full screen. Reference images supply the same character identities and richly textured luminous storybook painting style, NOT their bakery setting. Soft detailed fur, layered worn fabric, wet moss and copper leaves; amber lamp light against deep blue midnight rain. NOT plastic smooth fur. Subjects and ears fully inside upper two-thirds of each quadrant; leave bottom third atmospheric foreground for a translucent reading panel. Vary wide, medium, close and over-shoulder views.
CHARACTERS: Poppy is a small youthful cream rabbit, exactly TWO ears with one upright and the other gently bent sideways, plum embroidered cape, rust knitted scarf, worn brown satchel. Willow is slightly taller youthful grey-brown rabbit, exactly TWO upright ears, moss-green coat, no bag. Baker is adult brown hedgehog, cream apron over burgundy sleeves, no hat. Ferryman is adult brown OTTER, cream muzzle and whiskers, slate-blue raincoat, brown knitted cap, one ordinary handsaw. Other neighbours are adult woodland mammals in muted raincoats. No humans, no extra limbs/ears, no frogs baked in.
CONTINUITY: Present-time rainy NIGHT throughout, no dawn or sunshine. The high stone arch bridge is far upstream; signal rock is a broad safe rock on village-side slope BELOW that bridge. Quarry Shelter is a natural rocky overhang on the OPPOSITE hillside. Deep flooded gorge separates them. No direct bridge or stepping stones between rock and shelter. Poppy carries a small brass oil lamp with GLASS CHIMNEY. Willow's folded handmade paper lantern is HIDDEN until explicitly relit in sheet 3. Distant shelter has one tiny amber light only: no identifiable figures or bell visible there before arrival in sheet 5. No readable maps, marks, diagrams, injury detail or solution spoilers. All four cells must follow their specified beat exactly.
SHEET 1 / m21 The higher path. TOP LEFT: Outside the bakery at night, baker sets a separate lantern inside the window while an adult neighbour gathers folded canvas and two stout poles. Poppy with glass-chimney oil lamp and Willow prepare to leave, ferryman with saw. TOP RIGHT: Rear three-quarter wide view of the small party entering the garden path, bakery window a small warm square behind trees; Poppy and Willow together, adults carrying lamps/poles/canvas. BOTTOM LEFT: Fern-lined old stone steps. Adults carefully clear thorny stems; a large fallen BEECH LIMB, NOT a whole tree trunk, blocks the narrow track ahead. Rabbits safely waiting behind adults, Willow no visible lantern. BOTTOM RIGHT: Poppy raises her oil lamp beside baker at a broad safe mossy rock overlook. Looking across a deep gorge to a tiny anonymous light below a natural rock overhang on opposite hillside. Keep children well away from precipice. Mossy rock ledge at upper-middle left for an overlay frog, no drawn frog.

SHEET 2 / m22 An answering light. Same broad signal rock, rainy night. TOP LEFT: Medium Poppy cups paws to call across gorge; her oil lamp rests safely on the broad rock; baker close behind, Willow nearby with empty paws. TOP RIGHT: Scenery-only view into dark flooded gorge, rain and white water; opposite shelter light small and anonymous under overhang high on slope, no people visible. BOTTOM LEFT: Poppy holds glass-chimney oil lamp aloft to signal; warm rim light on fine fur, baker steady beside her, opposite tiny light visible across the gap. BOTTOM RIGHT: Ferryman faces opposite slope and calls, with Willow listening and Poppy holding the lamp. Keep village-side characters grouped safely behind broad rock, distant shelter remains too far away to recognise anyone. No graphic signal patterns, floating symbols or duplicate lamps for Poppy. Add textured fern/rock perch around x30%, y45% of top-right cell, no frog.

SHEET 3 / m23 Two useful jobs. TOP LEFT: Ferryman and adult neighbour saw the fallen beech limb beside old steps. Poppy and baker are farther back at the safe signal rock, NOT sawing. TOP RIGHT: Close two-character view, Willow carefully relights a small crumpled rectangular handmade AMBER PAPER lantern from the flame at Poppy's glass-chimney oil lamp. Paper lantern has thin wooden frame and paper windows, not metal or glass. Exactly one lantern per rabbit. BOTTOM LEFT: Ferryman hands folded unreadable map to Willow, who carries the now-glowing paper lantern; ordinary map paper angled away from viewer. Poppy stands by baker, looking towards distant shelter; she keeps oil lamp. BOTTOM RIGHT: Quiet emotional medium view Poppy decides to stay with baker at signal rock, oil lamp held steady, while Willow and adults turn towards cleared higher path behind them. They have NOT crossed yet; no injured travellers here.

SHEET 4 / m24 Across Alder Arch. TOP LEFT: Adults roll the sawn beech length clear of the steps; Willow waits with amber PAPER lantern, Poppy and baker remain farther behind at signal rock. TOP RIGHT: Close warm view baker wraps a plain dry scarf around Poppy's shoulders over her plum cape; Poppy's brass oil lamp rests on broad rock. Her original rust scarf remains beneath new shawl-like scarf. Rain, no Willow at rock now. BOTTOM LEFT: WIDE scenery-dominant view from signal rock, Poppy and baker small foreground silhouettes watching a distant line of three lights cross high single STONE ARCH bridge upstream. Willow's small paper lantern is between adult lamps, bodies too distant for detail. Deep gorge remains below; this bridge is far away, not connecting directly to signal rock. BOTTOM RIGHT: From Poppy/baker's same safe viewpoint, new small lamps gather at far hillside rocky overhang, with no recognisable distant faces. Poppy raises her oil lamp, hopeful. No travellers arriving at signal rock yet. Broad moss-covered shelf around x30%, y42% in top-right cell for frog overlay, no painted frog.

SHEET 5 / m25 What Willow noticed. Now AT Quarry Shelter on far hillside; Poppy and baker NEVER appear in any cell. Reference 3 establishes Bram: broad adult black-and-white BADGER, dark moss-green coat, small rounded ears, no hat. Mender: adult russet FOX woman, muted ochre travelling coat, grey shawl, seated with wrapped ankle kept modestly under hem. Apprentice: youthful tan RABBIT, two upright ears, faded blue coat, holds a closed brown rectangular work case, visually distinct from Willow. TOP LEFT: Establishing view beneath natural rock overhang: Bram rises as ferryman and Willow arrive with lamps, mender seated beside apprentice. Rope runs between two trees on slippery slope below as a handhold, NOT across gorge. TOP RIGHT: Closer view of rope tied securely round tree on same slope, Bram indicates it; mender remains seated higher under overhang and apprentice supports her. Willow listens with paper lantern. BOTTOM LEFT: Tense conversational scene: seated mender looks up to challenge Bram while adults unfold canvas stretcher; Bram looks uneasy, Willow quietly observant. No confession, no stolen timber, no close-up yellow stitching. BOTTOM RIGHT: Ferryman secures folded canvas to two wooden poles for stretcher; Willow holds her paper lantern steady, mender still seated beside apprentice; Bram helps with canvas, evasive expression. Safe overhang, no dangerous lifting or carrying yet. Keep mossy shelf around x28%, y42% of top-right cell clear for overlay frog. No frog drawn.
